_doc: Original monsters added on top of the wiki roster. Merged by build_data.py. Ability numbers are already engine coefficients (power x caster stat, mods as a fraction of the stat).

monsters.name: Moonreaver
monsters.lore: When a Dark Panther hunts beneath enough eclipses, its pelt hardens into bone-white crescents and moonlight burns along its veins. Moonreavers stalk only on moonless nights, when nothing can see them coming.

abilities.name: Night Hunt
abilities.text: Physical Damage (Death), +25% damage per kill made in battle

abilities.name: Lunar Howl
abilities.text: Lowers all foes' Attack and Magic

monsters.name: Seraph
monsters.lore: An Archangel that has carried a fragment of the sun for a hundred battles. The light it holds can mend any wound, or burn the darkness out of a demon's heart.

abilities.name: Angelic Wind
abilities.text: Removes Sleep, Paralyze, Poison, Confuse from all allies

abilities.name: Mighty Guard
abilities.text: Raises all allies' Defense and Resist

monsters.name: Empyrean
monsters.lore: The final ascension of the angel line. Six wings, a crown of crescent moons and a heart that is a living sun. Legends say Dragon Island was born at dawn beneath its gaze.

abilities.name: Sunfall Judgement
abilities.text: Magical Damage (Life) to all foes, +100% vs. Demonic

abilities.name: Sanctum
abilities.text: Heals all allies and removes bad effects

abilities.name: Wings of Dawn
abilities.text: Speeds up all allies' actions by 30%

abilities.name: Divine Grace
abilities.text: Immune from all bad status effects
